import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re

def getseq(acc):
    return requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()["sequence"]["value"]

# simple affine-gap Smith-Waterman, identity scoring (match +2, mismatch -1, gap -11/-1)
def sw(a,b,match=2,mis=-1,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); E=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9); F=np.full((n+1,m+1),-1e9)
    P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    best=0; bi=bj=0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E[i,j]=max(E[i,j-1]+ge, H[i,j-1]+go+ge)
            F[i,j]=max(F[i-1,j]+ge, H[i-1,j]+go+ge)
            d=H[i-1,j-1]+(match if ai==b[j-1] else mis)
            v=max(0,d,E[i,j],F[i,j]); H[i,j]=v
            P[i,j]= 0 if v==0 else (1 if v==d else (2 if v==E[i,j] else 3))
            if v>best: best,bi,bj=v,i,j
    A=[];B=[];i,j=bi,bj
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i,j]>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==1: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==2: A.append('-');B.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
        elif p==3: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append('-');i-=1
        else: break
    A=''.join(reversed(A));B=''.join(reversed(B))
    ident=sum(1 for x,y in zip(A,B) if x==y)
    return dict(score=best, alen=len(A), ident=ident, pid=100*ident/max(len(A),1),
                a_start=i+1,a_end=bi,b_start=j+1,b_end=bj, A=A, B=B)

LIH1=getseq("P47145")
print("=== Is the 'KmYJR107W' extracellular lipase really the LIH1 ortholog? ===")
for acc,lab in [("A0ABX6F1A9","K. marxianus PF01764, 389 aa (candidate KmYJR107Wp)"),
                ("A0ABX6ET63","K. marxianus PF01764, 544 aa (Atg15-like?)"),
                ("E0A7J0","Y. lipolytica Lip2 (secreted)"),
                ("P25641","S. cerevisiae Atg15"),
                ("O42807","A. niger FaeA (secreted)")]:
    s=getseq(acc)
    a=sw(LIH1,s)
    print(f"{acc} {lab}\n   SW: %id={a['pid']:.1f}%  alen={a['alen']}  LIH1 {a['a_start']}-{a['a_end']} vs target {a['b_start']}-{a['b_end']}  "
          f"GHSLG in target: {'GHSLG' in s}")
    print(f"   aligned region starts at target residue {a['b_start']} (target SP would be 1-~25)")

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P = pd.read_csv("lih1_panel_features.csv") if False else None
# recompute panel quickly
def q(query,size=300):
    return requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":query,"size":size,"format":"json"},timeout=180).json().get("results",[])
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2,X=0.,B=-3.5,Z=-3.5,U=2.5)
def kdv(s): return np.array([KD.get(c,0.) for c in s])
def hreg(s):
    v=kdv(s[:35]); return float(np.max(np.convolve(v,np.ones(11)/11,"valid"))) if len(v)>=11 else np.nan
rows=[]
for j in q("xref:pfam-PF01764 AND reviewed:true AND taxonomy_id:4751"):
    s=j["sequence"]["value"]; sig=[f for f in j.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Signal"]
    sub="; ".join(l["location"]["value"] for c in j.get("comments",[]) if c["commentType"]=="SUBCELLULAR LOCATION" for l in c.get("subcellularLocations",[]))
    uid=j.get("uniProtkbId","")
    g=("QUERY_LIH1" if j["primaryAccession"]=="P47145" else
       "Atg15 orthologues\n(signal anchor)" if ("ATG15" in uid or "AT15" in uid) else
       "Secreted fungal\nlipase_3" if (sig or "Secreted" in sub) else "other")
    rows.append(dict(acc=j["primaryAccession"],uid=uid,g=g,h=hreg(s)))
for j in q('organism_id:559292 AND reviewed:true AND cc_scl_term:SL-0091 AND NOT ft_signal:* AND NOT ft_transmem:*',300):
    s=j["sequence"]["value"]
    if len(s)>=120: rows.append(dict(acc=j["primaryAccession"],uid=j.get("uniProtkbId"),g="Cytosolic yeast\nproteins",h=hreg(s)))
D=pd.DataFrame(rows); D=D[D.g!="other"]
L=D[D.acc=="P47145"].h.iloc[0]

order=["Secreted fungal\nlipase_3","Atg15 orthologues\n(signal anchor)","Cytosolic yeast\nproteins"]

ax=axes[0]
for k,grp in enumerate(order):

    ax.scatter(x,v,s=26,alpha=.75,edgecolor='none',
               color=["#2563eb","#7c3aed","#9ca3af"][k],label=f"{grp.replace(chr(10),' ')} (n={len(v)})")
    ax.hlines(np.median(v),k-.25,k+.25,color='k',lw=2)
ax.axhline(1.818,ls='--',c='#dc2626',lw=1.3)
ax.text(2.45,1.86,"benchmark cutoff 1.82\n(AUC 0.97)",color='#dc2626',fontsize=8,ha='right')

ax.annotate("LIH1 (P47145)\n1.27",(0,L),xytext=(0.55,0.55),fontsize=9,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=1.1))

ax.set_ylabel("N-terminal h-region score\n(max 11-residue Kyte-Doolittle mean, residues 1-35)")
ax.set_title("LIH1 lacks the hydrophobic N-terminal core\nof every secreted Lipase_3 relative",fontsize=11)

ax=axes[1]
cols={"P47145":("#f59e0b","LIH1 (no signal)"),"E0A7J0":("#2563eb","Lip2 Y. lipolytica (SP 1-17)"),

      "P25641":("#be123c","Atg15 S. cerevisiae (anchor 15-35)")}
for acc,(c,lab) in cols.items():
    s=getseq(acc); v=kdv(s[:70]); sm=np.convolve(v,np.ones(9)/9,"valid")
    ax.plot(np.arange(5,5+len(sm)),sm,color=c,lw=2 if acc=="P47145" else 1.4,label=lab)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls=':',c='k',lw=1); ax.text(55,1.65,"TM / h-region threshold",fontsize=8)
ax.axhline(0,c='#d1d5db',lw=.8)
ax.set_xlabel("Residue position"); ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (9-residue window)")
ax.set_title("N-terminal hydropathy profiles",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper right")
